name: 2013 World Championships Deck: Anguille Sous Roche

releases.name: 2013 World Championships Deck: Anguille Sous Roche

description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Senior Division at the 2013 World Championships. Rayquaza-EX is the main attacker, powered by Eelektrik's Dynamotor; Raikou-EX hits Pokémon on the Bench, Victini handles Grass types, and Keldeo-EX with Float Stone makes switching attackers easy. The 2013 World Championships were held at the Vancouver Convention Centre in Vancouver, Canada, from 9 to 11 August 2013, the first outside the United States.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2013 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
